state.goal: Report production defects per 1,000 items, excluding trial records, with source support.
state.question: Choose the least costly eligible route for this bounded subtask of a CIDM-qualified project.

next.instructions: Choose one bounded route for a subtask inside a CIDM-qualified broader project. Use deterministic for exact operations with executable checks. Use direct_luna_low or direct_sol_high for a single bounded model call when a five-unit graph would be wasteful. Use five_unit only for meaningful decomposition and evidence dependencies. Stop for missing evidence or constraints. This is one typed decision; do not generate a prose plan or request more routing calls.

deterministic.description: Use exact code and source checks; no generative worker.

direct_luna_low.description: Use exactly one GPT-6 Luna low worker and task-specific hard checks; no Jev follow-up.

direct_sol_high.description: Use exactly one GPT-6 Sol high worker and task-specific hard checks; no Jev follow-up.

five_unit.description: Use the five-unit Jev network with post-worker decisions and optional Sol-high review.

retrieve_evidence.description: Stop for missing original evidence before doing work.

stop.description: Stop because no route can meet the stated constraints.
